messages:
rachel: fyi from the token postmortem: we're getting recurring auth failures clustered around deploys. want to align on ownership + timeline for mitigations.
tom: saw that too. looks like service caches don't expire on key rotation sometimes. reproducer attached in the issue.
arjun: i'll take the repro and try to make it deterministic in CI. quick ask: do we prefer forcing a cache-bust on rotation or a graceful reload?
kate: prefer graceful reload to avoid slam on downstream services. also need better audit events when rotation occurs (which key used, origin, who triggered).
ops-bot: created ticket INC-7392: "deploy-time token reload failures — mitigation plan" (https://issues.redwood/INC-7392)
rachel: proposed split of work: arjun -> CI repro + automated test; tom -> implement graceful reload + backoff; kate -> audit + retention specs; rachel -> runbook and rollout windows. proposed ETAs: repro: 72h, reload patch: 1 week, audit: 5 days, runbook: 3 days. any objections?
arjun: ack to 72h. plan: add a flaky test that toggles keys and restarts a service in a controlled env; will run as nightly and on PRs that touch auth. example snippet i'll use in tests: `kubectl exec -it $(svc_pod) -- /bin/sh -c "rotate-key && sleep 5 && curl -sS localhost:8080/health"`
tom: for reload i'll add a signal handler to the process to trigger key refresh rather than full restart, and add staggered retry windows to avoid herd. will also add an opt-in feature flag for legacy services. ETA: next tuesday.
kate: audit changes: add `auth.rotation` event with fields: `service_id`, `old_kid`, `new_kid`, `initiator`, `method`. retention: 120 days hot, 365 archived. i'll post mapping + sample kibana view. ETA: friday.
rachel: regarding recurring pattern: we see higher failure rates for deploys originating in eu-west region. ops team — are rolling deploys different there?
tom: yes, eu-west deploys run with shorter grace windows due to maintenance windows. we should standardize to the safer cadence. i'll update deploy controller config.
arjun: note: some services use in-memory verification caches; adding a cache TTL solves some but won't help immediate rotation. the signal handler is needed for correctness.
ops-bot: reminder: deploy-controller change PR assigned to tom (PR #2121)
rachel: runbook outline i'll prepare: incident detection (alerts), rollback criteria, quick rollback command, how to force reload, customer comms template. will post draft by EOD tomorrow.
kate: suggest alert `deploy.token_reload_failures > 1% over 5m` -> page oncall + create postmortem draft automatically.
arjun: i'll wire a synthetic that rotates a staging key daily to catch issues before prod. small script i'll add to repo: `./scripts/rotate-staging-key.sh --validate`
tom: will add logs to include `kid` on deny responses to help audits. also planning a small dashboard for token failure spikes by release.
rachel: summary action list: arjun: deterministic repro + nightly synthetic (ETA 72h) | tom: graceful reload + deploy-controller cadence standardization + log changes (ETA 1 week) | kate: audit event + retention + kibana view (ETA fri) | rachel: runbook + customer template + coordinate rollout (ETA tmrw EOD). please update INC-7392 with progress.
arjun: noted, updating ticket now.
tom: will push a WIP branch tomorrow and tag @rachel.
kate: will add mapping to the ticket and share saved view link when ready.
ops-bot: scheduled reminder set: follow-up sync in 4 days for status updates.
rachel: thanks team ":raised_hands:" — let's reduce these deploy-blink incidents for good.
